_licensing_reframe_2026-07-30: Fonts in CapCut's IN-APP library (e.g. Prosecco, Opera Cake, Solid) are usable by ANY CapCut user including buyers — so packs MAY include them without us redistributing files. We only need an OFL/owned FILE for fonts the ENGINE auto-renders (font_path patch). Trick to get a CapCut-only font's file for the engine: type it once in a CapCut text + save → CapCut caches the .ttf and writes its resource_id into the draft; read the draft, copy the cached file, wire it (how ZY Modern was captured). Cache dir: ~/Movies/CapCut/User Data/Cache/effect|AITextTemplate/.
